notes.title: Linux build
notes.content:
[p]I finally learned how to upload a Linux build of my game onto steam.[/p][p][/p][p]AI Stories can now be played on Linux mint 22.1. in a native way.[/p][p][/p][p]I honestly don’t know if it also plays well on other Linux distributions. It is not a flat pack build.[/p][p][/p][p]If you are facing compatibility issues on Linux, you can right click on the game in your steam library, go to properties, go to compatibility, activate “ Force the use of a specific Steam Play compatibility tool “ and then choose a runtime layer that works best for you.
[/p][p]I chose the Steam Linux Runtime 3.0 ( sniper ) to be the default runtime for Linux.[/p]

I changed almost all variables from a dynamic programming style to a static one.

This should lead to a bit of an improved performance.

I also changed the full screen toggle to two different buttons for full screen or windowed.

The game remembers the setting and automatically applies a full screen or windowed window size on start.

notes.title: New Godot version is under Construction
notes.content:
Hello.

Due to the recent events going on at Unity Technologies, makers of the Unity game engine which is used to make this game. I am currently completely rebuilding the Game inside the Godot Engine. I was already very close to finishing the Second Chapter, but then the story with Unity happened, and now I have to take the saver way and work with Godot.

The new Godot Version will feature way better and more fun Gameplay, seen in this little demonstration video.

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=KU0cjL4r9r0

You are also free to subscribe to the YouTube channel to see new devlog videos of AI Stories once they are out.

Don't worry, The world already looks more filled and fun than what is shown in the video. It's just a proof that I am still working on this project.

When the new version will be out, I will also change the tags and the description on the Steam page to fit to the new "style" the game has taken.

I will also provide a Soundtrack both on YouTube and here on Steam once the new version is out.

I hope that you will like the new Godot build of AI Stories and keep on having a wonderful time with the AIs.

Much love, Emir Akyazi.

I made the sounds a bit less loud and all Areal music pieces too.
Chapter 2 is 90% Finished.

I fixed a bug that was setting the default controls incorrectly, you may have to set them correct one more time, but otherwise it should be fine.
Chapter 2 is 80% Finished.

I added little 3D models to the place where the AI was writing about Food, and fixed a design mistake that makes the last portal open without collecting the keys. I just left the Portal object on, My fault!

notes.title: Free to Play change
notes.content: Hello, I was not capable to pay my bills due to almost nobody buying my game. I am going to delete my company and get myself a Job. The game will still be on Steam and I will change it to free to play, I am still working on updates and the next chapters. I just won't do so anymore as my main source of Income.
